development_information: Only existing 750 cases; continuous SNH_max_eval. Development exploration and baseline fits precede final prospective freeze and are disclosed.
old_test_role: The old 244 and 96 cases are not independent tests for M3 and are excluded from training and new primary evaluation.
target: native BSM1 effluent NH4 maximum over [60,67), mg N/L
process_objective: unweighted continuous peak squared error; residual divided by 4 mg N/L, a constant scaling only
profile_interpretation: Reoptimized development loss; not a confidence interval or physical identification.
statistical_supervision: Both regression baselines see the identical 750 continuous peaks; only L and alpha*KLa are learned input features.
statistical_selection: Three development scenario leave-one-group-out CV; transformations fitted within training folds only.
new_alpha_rule: alpha=0.7+0.3*L+q*(1-(0.7+0.3*L)); all within joint training hull; six new constant conditions, 15C.
extra_candidates: Union of first compliant dense-grid KLa minus/plus 2 for five new models, clipped to [40,520], excluding coarse. If >8 extras, take 8 rounded equally spaced order indices. Thus at most 15 candidates per condition. Selection uses frozen predictions only.
primary_evaluation: Report coarse and prediction-enriched strata separately; condition is design unit. Raw concentration RMSE/MAE, false releases/rejections, boundary and frozen gate are distinct metrics.
gate: Post-fit development max absolute peak residual b; direct compliant if prediction+b<4; direct noncompliant if prediction-b>4; otherwise reference. Joint/feature out-of-domain always reference. This is an empirical buffer, not a probability guarantee. All candidates receive independent scientific references for auditing.
half_step_checks: One prespecified candidate per new condition: closest full_calibrated predicted peak to 4, tie by KLa. 0.5-minute native recomputation after main references, with same pre-frozen identities.
historical_contextual_model: Original M2 parameters are evaluated on the same new candidates as legacy_M2_binary; it keeps binary supervision and is not an equal-continuous-supervision baseline. Its displayed Gate uses the new common concentration-buffer wrapper, not the original KLa Gate. It does not select new boundary candidates.
development_exploration: outputs/statistical_development and outputs/development_exploratory_01 retain earlier development-only runs. No new reference labels existed; final selected fits are rerun under strict source-hash binding.
